so_what: Eharmon1986 (1-3, 95 FAAB) keeps getting hit: his bridge QB Mariota sprained an MCL, Rice may miss weeks, Swift lost work to a fumble; he is the most motivated trade partner in the league.
sbbroom lost Barkley (likely out) and DeVonta Smith (unlikely) at once, with Higgins day-to-day, and has 100 FAAB to chase Shipley.
Seattle's lead back Emanuel Wilson is unrostered here, and BrylerAnderson, kate0826 and OrourkeP all need RB with 100 FAAB, so expect him to clear high in this 12-team league.
tyanserg stashed Tyreek Hill before he has a team; at 53 FAAB, the league's lowest, the bet pays only if Hill lands as a starter.
Bagent being named Chicago's starter makes OrourkeP's Caleb Williams a longer hold; Stroud is now his QB and RB is still his weak spot.
ColesMomPlays2Win is 1-3 with the strongest roster; Brian Robinson's goal-line TDs dent Bijan in this 6-point-TD format, but expect patience, not a sale.
kate0826 (RB 11th of 12 after cutting Hall) is the strong team most likely to trade WR depth for a back, with Chase in the concussion protocol.
